subject: Competitive synthesis + regression playbook and next sandbox runs
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan@novusai.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: nina.patel@acmeplatform.com
Date: 2028-03-09T15:12:00Z
Subject: Quick recap + specific comparison asks

Thanks for the call earlier — good conversation. Attached the recording for your team (meeting_recording_20280309.mp4).

High level asks we discussed that will determine next steps on our side: 
- Lightweight, comparable latency/cost numbers for your hosted API vs the two providers we currently use (BigCloud AI and HyperscaleX) for our customer-facing summarization flow (avg input token len ~ 450).
- Short eval prompts that exercise hallucination modes (knowledge cutoffs, factual QA, multi-step instructions) and baseline hallucination rate for your default model and the smaller quantized variant.
- A regression checklist for us to run in our sandbox: prompt-suite, expected tolerances (BLEU/ROUGE where applicable), and a quick way to validate KV-cache behavior under repeat prompts.

We'd like to schedule a sandbox run next week. If you can send a compact plan (who owns which test, expected runtime, artifacts we'll get back), we can sign off internally and set a date.

Jordan
Senior ML Engineer
NovusAI

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the recording.

Short plan from our side (owner in parentheses):
1) Competitive numbers (Ben): we'll run a short head-to-head on your summarization workload using a held-out sample you provide (we'll need ~200 representative items). Deliverable: per-model latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, and cost estimate at 5k qps-equivalent. Target: 48h.
2) Hallucination probes (Marissa): we already have a 60-prompt suite that hits knowledge-cutoff, arithmetic drift, and persona-conflict cases. I'll attach v1 and propose adding 30 of your domain-specific prompts. Deliverable: prompt-level hallucination flags and suggested mitigations (system prompt, model variant, reranking). Target: 72h.
3) Regression checklist & KV-cache validation (Karthik): small harness to replay repeated-prefixed requests and measure cache hits + memory behavior. We'll include a simple script you can run in your sandbox. Deliverable: checklist + runbook + pass/fail criteria. Target: 48h.

Ben/Marissa/Karthik — please see timeline above. Jordan, can you confirm you can share the 200-sample set and 30 domain prompts by Thursday (2028-03-11)? If yes we'll lock a sandbox start on Monday 2028-03-13.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
